requirements.statement: Semantic Analysis validates canonical distributed Function Contract v2 value-domain authority against exact PSM symbol ownership, static interfaces, and deterministic semantic value domains while leaving state/effect obligations to their owning analyzer.

Semantic Analysis conservatively refines supported control flow and propagates argument, parameter, return, assignment, wrapper, product, and recursive domains to a deterministic widened fixed point without narrowing a callee from current callers.

Semantic Analysis checks supported call preconditions, proves authored postconditions, detects understood partial-operation and impossible-state contradictions with abstract counter-domains, and preserves granular uncertainty rather than treating unsupported semantics as safe.

Semantic Analysis emits deterministic canonical summaries and derived Info bound to the PSM and Function Contract digests, and PROGRAM-DOMAIN-001 converts only supported contradictions into normalized findings.
